* (7-side) When calculating immunity to attrition, start with the base immunity and apply any modifiers (such as [[Darth Tyranus]]). Finally, apply the limit (limit of &lt; 4 from [[Master Yoda]]) last.
* For example, [[Master Windu]] (normally immune &lt; 6) would first be reduced to &lt; 5 by Tyranus first. Then the limit of &lt; 4 would be applied.
* For example, [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] (fully immune to attrition) would not be affected by Tyranus at all. Then the limit of &lt; 4 would be applied to Qui-Gon.

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Master Yoda (Errata)]]): PC re-rendering of the Virtual Set 16 images; card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi Knights or [Maintenance] cards; [Dagobah] Luke is deploy -1 and power and defense value +1; once per turn, may deploy a battleground with two [Dark Side] from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; once per game, may retrieve 1 Force.” Same game text words as the original; no E mark. The PC published a second, pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (format conversion only, no visible change).<ref name="img-rr7">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image: the side copyright line changed from “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” to “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, the artist credit line was reset (e.g. “ArtStation.com” → “ArtStation” on Grogu), and the game text was re-typeset (new line breaks). A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC errata of 12 December 2022; card image marked E1 published 12 December 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f434d313352448d45db14e080230103c086b1276 swccg-card-json commit f434d31335] (12 December 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi Knights, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards; your immunity to attrition is limited to &lt; 4; once per turn, may deploy a battleground with two [Dark Side] from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; once per game, may retrieve 1 Force.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 12 December 2022) quotes the original text. The card prints “E1”; it is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. The printed mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' “You may not deploy Jedi Knights or [Maintenance] cards; [Dagobah] Luke is deploy -1 and power and defense value +1” became “You may not deploy Jedi Knights, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards; your immunity to attrition is limited to &lt; 4”. The rest is unchanged. The card gained the E1 mark (printed).
